GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 56 (19 Sep 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 1217)
APO 500
19 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Loading of Repatriation Ships.
1. Memorandum for Imperial Japanese Government, AG 370.05 (15 June 46)GC, (SCAPIN-1025), subject: "Loading of Repatriation Ships," dated 15 June 1946, is hereby rescinded.
2. Effective 18 September 1946, authorized capacities of repatriation ships are as follows:
a. Liberty Ships - 3500
b. Landing Ships Tank - 1200
c. Japanese ships - 100% of capacity as rated prior to 15 June 1946.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will take the necessary steps to insure that ships loaded in Japan do not exceed the above listed capacities.
4. Masters of repatriation ships are being informed of the above through the Second Demobilization Ministry and Civilian Merchant Marine Committee.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
